summary: @kongaloosh Great dog. Thali, she was a mix breed a "mutt" best breed out there. Named for the Indian dish because she was a little of this and a little of that with luscious spice colored fur. Last dog older than our children.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @kongaloosh Great dog. Thali, she was a mix breed a "mutt" best breed out there. Named for the Indian dish because she was a little of this and a little of that with luscious spice colored fur. Last dog older than our children.
